description: This Java class 'EntityPermissionChecker' provides services for checking permissions on content entities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for permission validation, role and purpose retrieval, and permission condition evaluation, utilizing various helper classes and interfaces.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker
classes.description: Main class providing permission checking services for content entities, including methods for permission validation, role and purpose retrieval, and permission condition evaluation.

classes.name: PermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Interface for iterating over permission conditions, retrieving role, operation, status, privilege, and auxiliary values.

classes.name: StdPermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of PermissionConditionGetter, retrieves permission conditions from a list of GenericValue entities.

classes.name: AuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving auxiliary values related to permission checks.

classes.name: StdAuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of AuxiliaryValueGetter, retrieves auxiliary values from ContentPurpose entities.

classes.name: RelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving related roles for entities, including owner checks and initialization with ancestors.

classes.name: StdRelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of RelatedRoleGetter, retrieves roles from ContentRole entities and checks ownership.

methods.name: runPermissionCheck
methods.description: Performs permission check based on context map, including user session and request details.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Static methods to check permission for content, roles, purposes, and statuses, returning a map with permission status.

methods.name: checkPermissionMethod
methods.description: Core method to evaluate permission for a list of entity IDs, roles, purposes, statuses, and privileges.

methods.name: getNextEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the next entity from a list or cache based on ID or GenericValue.

methods.name: checkHasRoleOperations
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific role-based operations.

methods.name: hasMatch
methods.description: Determines if a given entity matches target operations, roles, purposes, and statuses.

methods.name: getRelatedPurposes
methods.description: Retrieves related purposes for an entity.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves user roles for an entity, including group memberships.

methods.name: isGroupMember
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to a specific group based on party relationships.
